title: event.subEvent
description: A list of occurrences of the [event](./models/event.json) when using the `single` or `multiple` [calendarType](./models/event-calendarType.json).

id.description: Index of the subEvent on the parent event. `0` for the first subEvent, `1` for the second event, and so on.

hasOvernightStay.description: Indicates whether this occurrence involves an overnight stay. Present in the response when it has been set, as `true` or `false`, and omitted when it was never set. Only applicable when the event has a term with id `0.57.0.0.0` ("Kamp of vakantie").

allOf.description:
The capacity of this occurrence. Only present in the response when it is known and the caller is allowed to edit the event.

When replacing an existing event, a subEvent without `capacity` keeps the capacity of the current subEvent with the same `startDate`. If the `startDate` changed, there is no match and the capacity becomes unknown. Send an empty object (`{}`) to clear it.
